opportunities.name: SMB AI workflow automation service
opportunities.problem: Small businesses have repetitive lead, reporting, customer communication and administrative workflows that consume owner/staff time.
opportunities.customer: Small businesses and service businesses with repetitive administrative workflows
opportunities.offer: A narrowly scoped workflow audit plus implementation of one measurable automation using free/low-cost tools where feasible.

opportunities.name: SMB AI customer intake and support assistant
opportunities.problem: SMBs increasingly use AI for customer service, but implementation and reliable integration remain uneven.
opportunities.customer: SMBs receiving repeated customer questions, enquiries or booking requests
opportunities.offer: A focused FAQ/intake assistant with a controlled knowledge base and human escalation path.

opportunities.name: SMB administrative and e-invoice workflow assistance
opportunities.problem: Administrative consistency, customer/supplier data quality and invoicing workflows create operational friction for Malaysian SMEs.
opportunities.customer: Malaysian SMEs that need cleaner administrative workflows but do not need a large custom system
opportunities.offer: Workflow mapping, data-cleanup automation and non-financial-control administrative tooling; accounting/tax decisions remain with qualified professionals.

opportunities.name: AI implementation/productization service
opportunities.problem: Businesses are adopting AI faster than they can integrate it reliably into existing workflows.
opportunities.customer: SMBs that already use AI tools but need a reliable, narrow implementation
opportunities.offer: Productized implementation of one business workflow with documentation, testing and handover.
